real_economy.text: The US economy continues to grow at a solid pace, supported by resilient consumer spending and strong business investment, particularly in AI. GDP growth accelerated to an annualized 3.4% in Q3 2026, as domestic demand strengthened despite a widening trade deficit.

consumer_spending.text: US consumer spending remains resilient as stock market gains boost wealth among higher-income households, but slower income growth is prompting households to dip into savings to sustain spending.
